test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: JKGI is related to OPLN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way. QRNP is related to VWSU. Which of the following is NOKM related to, following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bd97fcbb82c788e3a1b2103925267254f13e378ba6ccc3e70a1da128d00f4d9.png] ​

**Logic: '5' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

JKGI is related to OPLN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d774e7edb4d5820dbb90bab16d88c5b48ae6f294e7a6ab19bdf2fec68d8d76a7.png] 

QRNP is related to VWSU →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaa2f5008cea3829fdd9b90b644f7778ad938cf5e47b96ae22dfde373314941c.png] 

Similarly, NOKM will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac031ac742e70957d0dea18763672f71549da82c6c4e339e82185fbad83fb91b.png] 

Here, 'NOKM' is related to** 'STPR'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
